invalid.title: That link is not valid
invalid.body: It may have been mistyped, or the request may have been withdrawn. Ask whoever contacted you to send it again.

signedOut.title: {{firm}} has asked you for documents
signedOut.body: They sent this to {{hint}}. To answer, you need an Everstead account, and it does not have to use that address.
signedOut.advice: Sign up with a personal address you will keep. You can confirm your work address here afterwards, and everything you are sent stays yours if you leave.
signedOut.after: Once you are signed in, open this link again from the same email.

confirm.title: Is {{hint}} yours?
confirm.body: {{firm}} has been in touch at that address. Confirm it and their request appears in your account, along with anything else they send there.
confirm.bodyPlain: Confirm this address and anything an organisation sends there reaches your account.
confirm.why: We send a code to that address. Reading it is how you prove the inbox is yours. Nothing is added to your account without it.

code.title: Enter the code
code.body: We sent a six digit code to {{hint}}. It expires in ten minutes.
code.label: Your code

done.title: Address confirmed
done.body: {{email}} now belongs to your account. Anything sent there reaches you here, whichever address you sign in with.

already.title: That is already your address
already.body: You are signed in with it, so there is nothing to confirm. Whatever was sent there is already in your account.

noLink.title: Sign in to confirm an address
noLink.body: Adding an address to your account needs you signed in first, so we know which account it belongs to.
noLink.advice: If an organisation contacted you at an address you do not sign in with, open the link in their email once you are signed in and it will bring you back here.
